snippet.title: Earth Atlantis 2 - "Blast from the Past" Teaser
snippet.description:
Earth Atlantis 2

Earth Atlantis 2 is a fast-paced post-apocalyptic shoot 'em up set in a vast sunken world ruled by machine sea monsters. Pilot a heavily armed submarine through relentless Bullet Hell battles, hunt 20+ colossal bosses, explore breathtaking underwater ruins, and uncover lost secrets to save humanity.

For more information:
https://x.com/PixelPerfex

https://pixel-perfex.com/
